How it works

From your call to your new home

  1. 01

    You call or send a message

    Tell us what is moving, from where to where and when.

  2. 02

    Free estimate & packing

    We come to see the place if needed, then wrap everything with proper materials.

  3. 03

    Taking furniture apart

    Large furniture is taken apart, screws and fittings kept together.

  4. 04

    Loading & lifting

    Strapped and secured — by the stairs, the elevator or the furniture lift.

  5. 05

    On the road

    Straight to your new address, anywhere in Attica.

  6. 06

    Set up in your new home

    Furniture back together and in place. You just open the door.

      Packing inside the home

      The lift is set up in the street and the furniture comes down from the balcony to the truck — no stairs, no knocks.

    Questions

    Good to know before you move

    At a glance

    • Removals & transport — Pyrovolikos Theodoros

    How much does a move cost?
    It depends on volume, floors, access, distance and extra services (packing, furniture lift). The estimate is free: send us a few details or we come to see the place.
    When is a furniture lift needed?
    When the floor is high, the staircase narrow or the elevator too small. With the lift, furniture goes up through the balcony quickly and without damage to the building.
    Do you pack and wrap?
    Yes. We wrap furniture with proper materials, pack fragile items, take furniture apart and put it back together at your new place.
    Are my belongings insured?
    Insurance of the transported items is available for extra peace of mind. Ask us during the estimate.
    Which areas do you cover?
    We are based in Piraeus (Kallergi 20) and cover the whole of Attica.
    Do you work with businesses?
    Yes: office and shop moves, pallet transport, goods distribution, express transport and special transports.
    When can I call you?
    Every day, 06:00 – 19:00, on +30 690 906 2843.
